question: top-customer
text: Which customer has spent the most on paid orders, and how much?
answer: Garden Bistro has spent the most on paid orders, totaling 100550 cents.

args.sql: SELECT SUM(oi.quantity * p.price_cents) AS total_spent, c.name AS customer_name FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.id JOIN order_items oi ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.id WHERE o.status = 'paid' GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY total_spent DESC LIMIT 1
